style: Flat vector cartoon illustration in a playful picture-book style: bold simple shapes, clean dark outlines, bright saturated colors, soft flat shading, uncluttered background. One clear focal action that tells the whole story at a glance, with expressive faces. Landscape format, 3:2 (1536×1024). Absolutely no text, letters, numbers or logos anywhere in the image.

items.fr: Le chat se promène sur l'[aspirateur] comme sur un petit train.
items.sen: The cat rides on the vacuum cleaner like a little train.
items.szh: 猫咪坐在吸尘器上，像坐小火车一样。
items.scene: A happy grey cat sits proudly on top of a round robot vacuum cleaner that glides across a living-room floor. Behind them, a clean stripe on a dusty floor shows where the vacuum has passed.
items.hook: aspirer 吸 → aspirateur 吸尘器。

items.fr: Les deux enfants se battent avec des [oreillers] pleins de plumes.
items.sen: The two children are fighting with pillows full of feathers.
items.szh: 两个孩子拿着装满羽毛的枕头打枕头仗。
items.scene: Two laughing children in pyjamas have a pillow fight on a bed; one pillow has burst and white feathers fly everywhere in the bedroom.
items.hook: oreille 耳朵：枕着耳朵睡的东西 = 枕头。

items.fr: Le petit garçon ferme le [robinet] pour ne pas gaspiller l'eau.
items.sen: The little boy turns off the tap so as not to waste water.
items.szh: 小男孩关上水龙头，不浪费水。
items.scene: A small boy standing on a step stool at a kitchen sink firmly turns off a shiny chrome tap with both hands; one last drop of water hangs from the tap, and a potted plant on the windowsill smiles.
items.hook: ouvrir / fermer le robinet = 开 / 关水龙头。

items.fr: Le [patron] offre un gâteau à toute l'équipe pour fêter le contrat.
items.sen: The boss offers a cake to the whole team to celebrate the contract.
items.szh: 老板请全队吃蛋糕，庆祝签下合同。
items.scene: In a bright office, a cheerful boss in a suit and tie carries a huge cream cake towards his team of employees, who cheer and clap; a signed contract with a big stamp lies on the meeting table.
items.hook: patron 老板（女老板 patronne）。

items.fr: L'[imprimante] crache des feuilles partout dans le bureau !
items.sen: The printer is spitting sheets of paper all over the office!
items.szh: 打印机把纸吐得满办公室都是！
items.scene: An office printer has gone crazy and is shooting blank sheets of paper into the air like a fountain; an office worker with a coffee mug stares at it in shock as papers rain down.
items.hook: imprimer 打印 → imprimante 打印机。

items.fr: Pour son premier jour de [stage], Léa porte une pile de dossiers plus haute qu'elle.
items.sen: On the first day of her internship, Léa carries a pile of files taller than herself.
items.szh: 实习第一天，莱娅抱着一摞比她还高的文件。
items.scene: A young intern with a badge on her shirt (just a star, no writing) carries a wobbling tower of folders taller than herself through an office corridor; colleagues at their desks watch nervously.
items.hook: faire un stage = 实习（舞台是 scène，不是 stage）。

items.fr: Le petit écolier a un [cartable] presque aussi grand que lui.
items.sen: The little schoolboy has a schoolbag almost as big as he is.
items.szh: 小学生背着一个几乎和他一样大的书包。
items.scene: A tiny first-grade boy walks to school wearing an enormous red leather schoolbag on his back, almost as big as he is; he leans forward under its weight but smiles bravely.
items.hook: cartable = 小学生背的书包。

items.fr: La maîtresse dessine un énorme dinosaure à la [craie] sur le tableau.
items.sen: The teacher draws a huge dinosaur in chalk on the blackboard.
items.szh: 老师用粉笔在黑板上画了一只巨大的恐龙。
items.scene: In a classroom, a teacher holds a white stick of chalk and draws a huge friendly dinosaur on a green blackboard; amazed pupils watch from their desks. Chalk dust floats in the air.
items.hook: une craie 一支粉笔；à la craie 用粉笔。

items.fr: Pendant l'examen, Hugo [triche] en regardant les réponses écrites sur sa main.
items.sen: During the exam, Hugo cheats by looking at the answers written on his hand.
items.szh: 考试时，雨果偷看写在手上的答案作弊。
items.scene: In an exam room, a boy secretly peeks at scribbles inked on the palm of his hand (only squiggles, no readable letters) while the teacher behind him raises an eyebrow, about to catch him.
items.hook: tricher 作弊；tricheur 作弊的人。

items.fr: Maman met un [pansement] sur le genou de sa fille qui est tombée du vélo.
items.sen: Mum puts a plaster on her daughter's knee after she fell off her bike.
items.szh: 妈妈给从自行车上摔下来的女儿膝盖贴上创可贴。
items.scene: On a sunny path, a mother kneels and sticks a colourful plaster on her little daughter's scraped knee; a small bicycle lies on its side next to them and the girl wipes a tear.
items.hook: panser 包扎 → pansement 创可贴、绷带。

items.fr: Avec ses [béquilles], le footballeur regarde le match depuis le banc.
items.sen: On his crutches, the footballer watches the match from the bench.
items.szh: 那名足球运动员拄着拐杖，在替补席上看比赛。
items.scene: A football player in his team kit, with a plaster cast on one leg, leans on a pair of crutches next to the team bench and watches his teammates play on the pitch.
items.hook: béquilles 一般成对用：marcher avec des béquilles 拄拐走路。

items.fr: L'éléphant [éternue] si fort que tous les ballons s'envolent.
items.sen: The elephant sneezes so hard that all the balloons fly away.
items.szh: 大象打了一个超大的喷嚏，所有气球都飞走了。
items.scene: At a birthday party, a big friendly elephant sneezes enormously through its trunk; the blast sends a bunch of colourful balloons flying up into the sky while the guests hold on to their hats.
items.hook: éternuer 打喷嚏；别人打喷嚏时说 « À vos souhaits ! »。

items.fr: À l'aéroport, le chien tend son [passeport] au douanier avec fierté.
items.sen: At the airport, the dog proudly hands his passport to the customs officer.
items.szh: 在机场，小狗得意地把护照递给海关人员。
items.scene: At an airport passport-control desk, a little dog wearing sunglasses and pulling a tiny suitcase proudly holds up a dark red passport (no writing on it) to a surprised customs officer.
items.hook: passer 通过 + port 港口：过关用的证件。

items.fr: Perdu dans la forêt, le randonneur suit sa [boussole] vers le nord.
items.sen: Lost in the forest, the hiker follows his compass towards the north.
items.szh: 在森林里迷了路，徒步者跟着指南针往北走。
items.scene: In a thick, dark forest, a hiker with a big backpack holds out a round compass whose red needle glows; he follows the direction it points, through the trees towards a bright clearing.
items.hook: boussole = 指南针。

items.fr: Le vent emporte la [tente], et les campeurs se réveillent à la belle étoile.
items.sen: The wind blows the tent away, and the campers wake up under the open sky.
items.szh: 风把帐篷吹走了，露营的人醒来时头顶是满天星星。
items.scene: At night in a campsite, a gust of wind carries an orange tent up into the starry sky like a kite, while two campers in sleeping bags sit up on the ground, blinking in surprise.
items.hook: planter la tente 搭帐篷；à la belle étoile 露天。

items.fr: Après l'orage, un [arc-en-ciel] apparaît au-dessus du village.
items.sen: After the storm, a rainbow appears above the village.
items.szh: 暴风雨过后，村庄上空出现了一道彩虹。
items.scene: Above a small French village with red roofs and a church tower, dark storm clouds move away and a bright, complete rainbow arches across the sky; puddles shine on the street.
items.hook: arc 弓 + en + ciel 天空：挂在天上的弓 = 彩虹。

items.fr: L'[écureuil] cache des noisettes dans le chapeau du jardinier.
items.sen: The squirrel is hiding hazelnuts in the gardener's hat.
items.szh: 松鼠把榛子藏进园丁的帽子里。
items.scene: In a garden, a red squirrel stuffs hazelnuts into a straw hat lying on a bench, while the gardener, a few steps away and unaware, rakes leaves.
items.hook: écureuil 松鼠，爱囤 noisettes 榛子。

items.fr: Des touristes en imperméable prennent une photo devant la [cascade].
items.sen: Tourists in raincoats are taking a photo in front of the waterfall.
items.szh: 穿着雨衣的游客在瀑布前拍照。
items.scene: A tall, powerful waterfall crashes down a green cliff into a pool; in front of it, a group of tourists in colourful raincoats pose for a photo, soaked by the spray.
items.hook: cascade = 瀑布。

items.fr: Une [foule] immense attend l'arrivée du Tour de France.
items.sen: A huge crowd is waiting for the Tour de France to arrive.
items.szh: 一大群人在等环法自行车赛的选手到来。
items.scene: A huge crowd of excited spectators lines both sides of a mountain road, waving and cheering, as the first cyclists in bright jerseys appear around the bend.
items.hook: une foule 一大群人；une foule de 许多……。

items.fr: Sur la mairie, le [drapeau] bleu, blanc, rouge flotte au vent.
items.sen: On the town hall, the blue, white and red flag is flying in the wind.
items.szh: 市政厅上，蓝白红三色旗迎风飘扬。
items.scene: A French town hall with a clock and a balcony; a large blue, white and red flag flies in the wind on a pole above the entrance. Pigeons sit on the roof. No writing anywhere.
items.hook: drap 布 → drapeau 旗子。

items.fr: Une vieille dame glisse son bulletin dans l'[urne] avec un grand sourire.
items.sen: An old lady slips her ballot into the ballot box with a big smile.
items.szh: 一位老奶奶笑眯眯地把选票投进投票箱。
items.scene: In a polling station, a smiling elderly lady drops an envelope into a transparent ballot box on a table; voting booths with curtains stand behind her.
items.hook: aller aux urnes = 去投票。

items.fr: Avec ses [écouteurs], Paul n'entend pas le chien qui aboie.
items.sen: With his headphones on, Paul doesn't hear the dog barking.
items.szh: 保罗戴着耳机，听不见狗在叫。
items.scene: A teenage boy with big headphones nods happily to music with his eyes closed, while right behind him a small dog barks loudly at him, holding its lead in its mouth.
items.hook: écouter 听 → écouteurs 耳机（常用复数）。

items.fr: Le robot [branche] son câble pour recharger sa batterie.
items.sen: The robot plugs in its cable to recharge its battery.
items.szh: 机器人插上电线给电池充电。
items.scene: A tired little robot with a low-battery symbol on its chest plugs its own cable into a wall socket; little lightning sparks show the electricity flowing.
items.hook: brancher 插电、接上；débrancher 拔掉。

items.fr: Avec la télécommande, papi [zappe] d'une chaîne à l'autre.
items.sen: With the remote control, Grandpa flicks from one channel to another.
items.szh: 爷爷拿着遥控器不停地换台。
items.scene: A grandfather slumped in an armchair points a remote control at a TV; the screen is shown split into several different programmes (a cooking show, a football match, cartoons) to show him changing channels.
items.hook: zapper = 不停换台。

items.fr: Quand Tom lui offre des fleurs, Julie [rougit] jusqu'aux oreilles.
items.sen: When Tom gives her flowers, Julie blushes right up to her ears.
items.szh: 汤姆送花给朱莉时，她脸红到了耳根。
items.scene: A boy holds out a bunch of flowers to a girl; her cheeks and ears turn bright red and she covers her mouth with her hand, smiling shyly.
items.hook: rouge 红 → rougir 变红、脸红。

items.fr: En épluchant les oignons, le cuisinier [pleure] à chaudes larmes.
items.sen: Peeling the onions, the cook is crying his eyes out.
items.szh: 厨师切洋葱，眼泪哗哗地流。
items.scene: A cook in a white hat peels a pile of onions at a kitchen counter; big streams of tears pour down his face like two little fountains.
items.hook: pleurer 哭 ↔ rire 笑。

items.fr: La petite fille [timide] se cache derrière la jambe de son papa.
items.sen: The shy little girl hides behind her dad's leg.
items.szh: 害羞的小女孩躲在爸爸腿后面。
items.scene: At a party, a shy little girl hides behind her father's leg and peeks out at a group of other children who wave at her.
items.hook: timide = 害羞的（阴阳同形）。

items.fr: Il fait beau, et [pourtant] Marc sort avec un énorme parapluie.
items.sen: It's sunny, and yet Marc goes out with a huge umbrella.
items.szh: 天气很好，可是马克还是撑着一把大伞出门。
items.scene: Under a bright sun and a perfectly blue sky, a man walks down a street holding a gigantic umbrella over his head; passers-by in sunglasses and T-shirts look at him, puzzled.
items.hook: pourtant = 可是（结果出乎意料）。

items.fr: [Dès que] la cloche sonne, les élèves courent dans la cour.
items.sen: As soon as the bell rings, the pupils run into the playground.
items.szh: 铃声一响，学生们就冲进操场。
items.scene: A school bell rings on a wall (sound waves around it) and at the same instant a crowd of happy pupils bursts out of the school door and runs into the playground.
items.hook: dès que = 一……就（马上）。

items.fr: [À cause de] la neige, le bus est bloqué au milieu de la route.
items.sen: Because of the snow, the bus is stuck in the middle of the road.
items.szh: 因为下雪，公交车被困在路中间。
items.scene: A city bus is stuck in deep snow in the middle of a country road; the driver scratches his head and the passengers look out of the windows at the snowflakes.
items.hook: à cause de 引出坏结果的原因；好结果用 grâce à。

items.fr: Le petit chef porte un [tablier] couvert de farine.
items.sen: The little chef is wearing an apron covered in flour.
items.szh: 小厨师穿着一条沾满面粉的围裙。
items.scene: A little child in a chef's hat stands proudly in a kitchen wearing a big apron completely covered in flour, holding a rolling pin; flour clouds and dough are all around.
items.hook: tablier = 围裙。

items.fr: Mamie bat les œufs avec un [fouet] à toute vitesse.
items.sen: Granny is beating the eggs with a whisk at top speed.
items.szh: 奶奶飞快地用打蛋器打鸡蛋。
items.scene: A cheerful grandmother whisks eggs in a big bowl so fast that her metal whisk is a blur with speed lines; drops of egg fly out and a cat watches, amazed.
items.hook: fouet 原义是“鞭子”，打蛋器像小鞭子一样抽打。

items.fr: Le pâtissier [saupoudre] du sucre glace sur les gaufres comme de la neige.
items.sen: The pastry chef sprinkles icing sugar over the waffles like snow.
items.szh: 糕点师把糖粉撒在华夫饼上，像下雪一样。
items.scene: A pastry chef holds a small sieve high above a plate of waffles and sprinkles white icing sugar, which falls on them like snow.
items.hook: sel 盐 + poudre 粉：撒粉。

items.fr: Le bébé est assis dans le [chariot] au milieu des légumes.
items.sen: The baby is sitting in the shopping trolley among the vegetables.
items.szh: 宝宝坐在购物车里，周围都是蔬菜。
items.scene: In a supermarket aisle, a baby sits happily inside a shopping trolley surrounded by vegetables, holding a carrot like a microphone; a parent pushes the trolley.
items.hook: chariot 购物车、手推车。

items.fr: Pendant les [soldes], les clients se précipitent dans le magasin dès l'ouverture.
items.sen: During the sales, customers rush into the shop as soon as it opens.
items.szh: 打折季期间，商店一开门顾客就蜂拥而入。
items.scene: Early in the morning, a crowd of shoppers rushes through the opening doors of a clothes shop; the shop windows are decorated with big red percentage symbols but no words.
items.hook: les soldes 打折季（总是复数）。

items.fr: Sur l'[étiquette] de la robe, l'ancien prix est barré en rouge.
items.sen: On the dress's price tag, the old price is crossed out in red.
items.szh: 裙子的价签上，原价被红笔划掉了。
items.scene: Close-up of a shopping hand holding up a price tag attached to a dress on a hanger; on the tag, a line of squiggles (the old price, no readable digits) is crossed out with a red line and a smaller squiggle is circled.
items.hook: étiquette 标签（也有“礼仪”的意思）。

items.fr: Le grand-père et son petit-fils font voler un [cerf-volant] en forme de dragon.
items.sen: The grandfather and his grandson are flying a dragon-shaped kite.
items.szh: 爷爷和孙子在放一只龙形风筝。
items.scene: On a windy beach, a grandfather and his grandson hold the string of a big colourful dragon-shaped kite flying high in the sky.
items.hook: cerf 鹿 + volant 会飞的：会飞的鹿 = 风筝。

items.fr: Toute la famille descend la colline sur une seule [luge].
items.sen: The whole family slides down the hill on one single sledge.
items.szh: 一家人挤在一个雪橇上滑下山坡。
items.scene: A whole family (parents, two kids and a dog) squeezed onto one small wooden sledge zooms down a snowy hill, laughing, with snow spraying behind them.
items.hook: faire de la luge = 坐雪橇滑雪。

items.fr: Pendant sa [plongée], Emma rencontre une tortue de mer.
items.sen: During her dive, Emma meets a sea turtle.
items.szh: 潜水时，艾玛遇到了一只海龟。
items.scene: Underwater in clear blue sea, a diver with a mask, fins and an oxygen tank meets a friendly sea turtle face to face among coral and small fish; bubbles rise.
items.hook: plonger 潜入 → plongée 潜水。

items.fr: À la fin du spectacle, le [rideau] rouge tombe sous les applaudissements.
items.sen: At the end of the show, the red curtain falls to applause.
items.szh: 演出结束，红色的幕布在掌声中落下。
items.scene: In a theatre, the heavy red velvet curtain comes down over the stage while the actors bow; in the foreground, the audience applauds and someone throws a rose.
items.hook: rideau 窗帘；（舞台）幕布。

items.fr: Le peintre tient son [pinceau] entre les dents pour se gratter la tête.
items.sen: The painter holds his paintbrush between his teeth to scratch his head.
items.szh: 画家把画笔叼在嘴里，腾出手来挠头。
items.scene: A painter in a beret stands in front of an unfinished canvas, holding a paintbrush between his teeth and scratching his head with a puzzled look; a palette is in his other hand.
items.hook: pinceau 画笔、刷子。

items.fr: Sur le pont, un musicien joue du [violon] pour les passants.
items.sen: On the bridge, a musician plays the violin for passers-by.
items.szh: 桥上，一位乐手为路人拉小提琴。
items.scene: On an old stone bridge over the Seine, a street musician plays the violin with feeling; music notes float in the air and a few passers-by stop to listen, one drops a coin in his open case.
items.hook: jouer du violon = 拉小提琴（乐器用 jouer de）。

items.fr: Le chat ronronne à côté du [berceau] où dort le bébé.
items.sen: The cat purrs next to the cradle where the baby is sleeping.
items.szh: 猫咪在宝宝睡觉的摇篮旁边打呼噜。
items.scene: In a cosy nursery at night, a baby sleeps peacefully in a wooden cradle; a cat curls up on the rug right next to the cradle, purring (little 'z' shapes but no letters).
items.hook: bercer 摇（宝宝）→ berceau 摇篮。

items.fr: Après un an d'absence, le grand frère fait un gros [câlin] à sa petite sœur.
items.sen: After a year away, the big brother gives his little sister a big hug.
items.szh: 离家一年后，哥哥给了妹妹一个大大的拥抱。
items.scene: At a train station platform, a young man with a backpack and suitcase kneels and gives his little sister a huge hug; she has jumped into his arms, overjoyed.
items.hook: faire un câlin 抱一抱。

items.fr: La mère [gronde] le chien qui a mangé ses chaussures.
items.sen: The mother scolds the dog that ate her shoes.
items.szh: 妈妈在训那只啃了她鞋子的狗。
items.scene: A mother with hands on her hips scolds a guilty-looking puppy sitting next to a chewed-up high-heeled shoe; the puppy flattens its ears and looks away.
items.hook: gronder 训斥（原义是“打雷”）。

items.fr: Le soir, les [lampadaires] s'allument un par un le long de la rue.
items.sen: In the evening, the street lamps light up one by one along the street.
items.szh: 傍晚，街边的路灯一盏接一盏亮起来。
items.scene: At dusk, along a Parisian street, a row of old-fashioned street lamps light up one after the other: the nearest ones glow warm yellow and the farther ones are still off.
items.hook: lampe 灯 → lampadaire 路灯、落地灯。

items.fr: Le canard et ses petits attendent sagement au [feu rouge].
items.sen: The duck and her ducklings wait patiently at the red light.
items.szh: 鸭妈妈带着小鸭子们乖乖地等红灯。
items.scene: At a city crossing, a mother duck and a line of ducklings wait in a neat row on the pavement in front of a traffic light that is red; cars wait too.
items.hook: feu rouge 红灯，feu vert 绿灯。

items.fr: Deux vieux amis jouent aux échecs sur un [banc] du parc.
items.sen: Two old friends are playing chess on a park bench.
items.szh: 两位老朋友坐在公园长椅上下棋。
items.scene: In a leafy park, two old men sit at either end of a green wooden bench with a chessboard between them, concentrating on their game; pigeons watch from the ground.
items.hook: banc 长椅（banque 才是银行）。

items.fr: Le policier met les [menottes] au voleur de croissants.
items.sen: The police officer puts handcuffs on the croissant thief.
items.szh: 警察给偷可颂的小偷戴上手铐。
items.scene: Outside a bakery, a police officer puts a pair of handcuffs on a sheepish thief whose striped shirt is stuffed with stolen croissants; the baker points at him.
items.hook: main 手 → menottes 手铐（总是复数）。

items.fr: Le [cambrioleur] entre par la fenêtre, mais le chien l'attend.
items.sen: The burglar climbs in through the window, but the dog is waiting for him.
items.szh: 盗贼从窗户爬进来，可狗正等着他呢。
items.scene: At night, a burglar in a black mask and striped shirt with a sack climbs in through a window, and comes face to face with a big dog sitting right underneath, waiting for him with a grin.
items.hook: cambrioler 入室行窃 → cambrioleur（比 voleur 更具体）。

items.fr: Le cuisinier éteint le feu de la poêle avec un [extincteur].
items.sen: The cook puts out the fire in the frying pan with an extinguisher.
items.szh: 厨师用灭火器扑灭了平底锅里的火。
items.scene: In a kitchen, flames shoot up from a frying pan on the stove; a cook aims a red fire extinguisher at it and white foam covers the pan.
items.hook: éteindre 熄灭 → extincteur 灭火器。

items.fr: Avec un énorme [aimant], le savant attire toutes les cuillères de la cuisine.
items.sen: With a huge magnet, the scientist attracts all the spoons in the kitchen.
items.szh: 科学家用一块巨大的磁铁，把厨房里的勺子全吸了过来。
items.scene: A scientist in a lab coat holds up a giant red horseshoe magnet; spoons, forks and saucepans fly out of a kitchen drawer and stick to it.
items.hook: aimant 磁铁（aimer 爱 → 互相吸引）。

items.extra: regarder à la loupe 仔细查看
items.fr: Le détective observe une empreinte avec sa [loupe].
items.sen: The detective examines a footprint with his magnifying glass.
items.szh: 侦探拿放大镜观察一个脚印。
items.scene: A detective in a trench coat and hat kneels on the floor and looks at a muddy footprint through a big magnifying glass; the footprint appears huge in the lens.
items.hook: loupe 放大镜；regarder à la loupe 仔细查看。

items.fr: La chimiste verse un liquide vert dans une [éprouvette], et une fumée violette sort.
items.sen: The chemist pours a green liquid into a test tube, and purple smoke comes out.
items.szh: 化学家把绿色液体倒进试管，冒出了紫色的烟。
items.scene: In a laboratory, a chemist with safety goggles pours a green liquid from a flask into a test tube held in a rack; a puff of purple smoke rises from the tube.
items.hook: éprouver 检验 → éprouvette 试管。

items.fr: Le monsieur [chauve] se regarde dans le miroir avec une perruque à la main.
items.sen: The bald man looks at himself in the mirror with a wig in his hand.
items.szh: 秃顶的先生手里拿着假发照镜子。
items.scene: A completely bald man looks at his shiny head in a bathroom mirror, holding a curly wig in one hand and wondering whether to put it on.
items.hook: chauve = 秃头的（阴阳同形）。

items.fr: La petite fille aux cheveux [frisés] ressemble à un petit mouton.
items.sen: The little girl with curly hair looks like a little sheep.
items.szh: 那个卷头发的小女孩像一只小绵羊。
items.scene: A smiling little girl with a big cloud of tight white-blond curls stands next to a fluffy sheep in a meadow; their curly hair and wool look exactly alike.
items.hook: frisé 卷的；la salade frisée 卷叶生菜。

items.fr: Le marin montre fièrement le [tatouage] d'ancre sur son bras.
items.sen: The sailor proudly shows the anchor tattoo on his arm.
items.szh: 水手得意地展示手臂上的船锚文身。
items.scene: On a harbour, a sailor in a striped shirt flexes his arm to proudly show a big blue anchor tattoo; seagulls and boats are behind him.
items.hook: tatouage 文身。

items.fr: Trois amis [poussent] la vieille voiture en panne.
items.sen: Three friends are pushing the old car that has broken down.
items.szh: 三个朋友在推那辆抛锚的旧车。
items.scene: On a country road, three friends lean with all their strength against the back of a small old car that has broken down, with steam coming out of the engine.
items.hook: pousser 推 ↔ tirer 拉（门上常写 Poussez / Tirez）。

items.fr: Le petit chien [tire] son maître vers le parc.
items.sen: The little dog pulls its owner towards the park.
items.szh: 小狗拉着主人往公园跑。
items.scene: A small energetic dog on a lead pulls its owner, who leans back and almost loses his balance, towards the gate of a green park.
items.hook: tirer 拉 ↔ pousser 推。

items.fr: Le serveur [glisse] sur une peau de banane avec son plateau.
items.sen: The waiter slips on a banana skin with his tray.
items.szh: 服务员端着托盘踩到香蕉皮滑倒了。
items.scene: In a café, a waiter carrying a tray of drinks steps on a banana skin and slips, one leg up in the air; the glasses fly off the tray.
items.hook: glisser 滑；glissant 滑的。
